area: Command Deck connector card — CC_WRITE_VERB tripwire vs Showami's read recipe names (dashboard, not edited)
finding: The card tests every verbsEnabled string against /(\bact\b|request|confirm|cancel|reschedul|post|accept|assign|book|hire|send|submit|sign|upload|delete|creat|updat|fill|pay|invit|messag|click|type)/i and a single match turns that row AND the whole card red with 'STOP. Three of Showami's four READ recipes match it — my-requests and request-status on 'request', posted-price on 'post' — as does ShowingTime's showing-status on nothing but its neighbours are close. A local scan of the verb lists P2 first composed matched three entries, all read-only.
fix: Two halves. Now, in the document: list verb GROUPS only (recipe, fs ls, fs cat, fs grep, fs pwd, page info, page open, session status) and never a recipe name — the card prints the recipe names itself from its own baseline. That rule is written into the template, into §9's prompt and into the connector skill. Properly, on the deck (owner's call, P2 may not edit a dashboard): word-bound the alternatives the same way 'act' already is, or match only the leading verb token of each entry — e.g. test /^(\s*)(act|request|confirm|…)\b/i against the first word rather than a substring anywhere in the string.
